faqs.question: Why is AngularJS suitable for building Single Page Applications (SPAs)?
faqs.answer: AngularJS provides built-in two-way data binding, dependency injection, and comprehensive routing capabilities, allowing developers to create rich, responsive single-page web applications without constant page reloads.

faqs.question: Can you help migrate our AngularJS application to modern Angular or React?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in legacy migration strategies, enabling smooth transitions to modern Angular, React, or Next.js with minimal downtime and zero data loss.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the security of AngularJS applications?
faqs.answer: We implement strict Content Security Policies (CSP), sanitize inputs to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), implement secure authentication flows, and routinely audit third-party dependencies.

faqs.question: How do I hire dedicated AngularJS developers from Techbeeps?
faqs.answer: You can choose from flexible engagement models including dedicated developers, fixed-price projects, or hourly time-and-material contracts tailored to your development schedule and budget.

faqs.question: Do you provide ongoing support after the project is deployed?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer comprehensive post-launch support and maintenance packages covering bug fixes, performance monitoring, feature enhancements, and version upgrades.
